meta.name: pipeline-chipseq
meta.description: Execute ENCODE ChIP-seq processing pipeline from FASTQ to peaks and signal tracks. Child of pipeline-guide. Provides stage-by-stage Nextflow execution with Docker containers and cloud deployment. Use when users need to process ChIP-seq data following ENCODE standards, run peak calling with MACS2, perform IDR analysis, or generate signal tracks. Trigger on: ChIP-seq pipeline, run ChIP-seq, process ChIP-seq, MACS2 peak calling, IDR analysis, ChIP-seq FASTQ processing.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云上运行标准化的ChIP-seq分析流程。
